title: Zesty Crunchy Australian Lamb Skillet
description: A solo-dinner Australian dish featuring garlicky and crunchy lamb, cooked with sweet sherry and render-fat, friendly to ayurvedic tamasic diets. This recipe is perfect for a hearty dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sweet sherry to the skillet and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add the rendered lamb fat, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the skillet and cook until heated through, about 2-3 minutes.
Sprinkle the crushed crackers over the top of the lamb and cook for an additional minute, until crispy.
Serve the lamb hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
